source.title: 60 Minute Full Body Dumbbell Workout [Strength & Conditioning]

notes: 4 sets of 12 moves, 40 s work + 20 s rest, a 60 s REST screen between sets. Work timer in a ring on the floor, rest timer in a ring top left; the name only on the NEXT / UP FIRST screens bottom centre, in the rest before the move (the caption is wider than the old box). Warm-up names sit in a small NEXT box bottom left during the move before. Expected derived from the countdown (each move starts at its 39, ±1 s). Cool-down: Snow Angels + five unnamed 30 s moves (null). The video spells FRENCH PRESS as FRNCH.
